youtube.title: What if you were in the cell next to El Chapo the night he vanished?
youtube.description:
Altiplano, July 11, 2015: hammering through the wall. ⛓️ At 8:52 p.m. he steps behind the shower wall – and drops into a 1.5 km tunnel with a motorcycle on rails. 🏍️ Guards open his cell 37 minutes later.
You hear hammering through the wall. What do you do? A) Call the guards B) Stay silent C) Bang on the wall – Comment A, B or C 👇
Sources: AP, PBS Frontline, Vice (Altiplano escape, July 2015)
